ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) ransomware safe-mode reboot persistence via bcdedit + SafeBoot service registration
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Qilin pre-encryption maneuver of forcing a reboot into Safe Mode (Network/Minimal) so the ransomware can run while EDR, AV, and most third-party defenses are not loaded. Looks for bcdedit safeboot configuration and registry writes under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SafeBoot\* to whitelist the encryptor service before reboot.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" (Processes.process="*safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*/set*{default}*safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*safeboot network*" OR Processes.process="*safeboot minimal*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user, ".*\$$") | append [| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Registry.registry_path) as reg_path values(Registry.registry_value_name) as reg_value values(Registry.registry_value_data) as reg_data values(Registry.process_name) as proc from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.registry_path="*\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\SafeBoot\\Network\\*" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\SafeBoot\\Minimal\\*" by Registry.dest Registry.user Registry.registry_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)`] | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let SafeBootProc = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/set", "-set")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessParentFileName, ReportId, DeviceId,
              Signal="bcdedit_safeboot";
let SafeBootReg = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
    | where RegistryKey has @"\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SafeBoot\Network"
         or RegistryKey has @"\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SafeBoot\Minimal"
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("trustedinstaller.exe","msiexec.exe")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              FileName=InitiatingProcessFileName, ProcessCommandLine=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName=InitiatingProcessParentFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine="",
              InitiatingProcessParentFileName="", ReportId, DeviceId,
              Signal=strcat("safeboot_reg:",RegistryKey,":",RegistryValueName);
let RecoveryDisable = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("catalog","backup"))
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessParentFileName, ReportId, DeviceId, Signal="recovery_inhibit";
union SafeBootProc, SafeBootReg, RecoveryDisable
| summarize EarliestSignal=min(Timestamp), LatestSignal=max(Timestamp),
            Signals=make_set(Signal,20),
            SampleCmd=any(ProcessCommandLine),
            Parents=make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName,10)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where array_length(Signals) >= 2  // safeboot config + recovery-inhibit on same host/user/hour = Qilin pre-encryption staging
| order by EarliestSignal desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let SafeBootProc = SecurityEvent

    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe"
    | where CommandLine has "safeboot"
    | where CommandLine has_any ("/set","-set")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$" and TargetUserName !endswith "$"
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, User=coalesce(TargetUserName,SubjectUserName),

let RecoveryDisable = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has_any ("catalog","backup"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, User=coalesce(TargetUserName,SubjectUserName),
              NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, Signal="recovery_inhibit";
union SafeBootProc, RecoveryDisable
| summarize Earliest=min(TimeGenerated), Latest=max(TimeGenerated),
            Signals=make_set(Signal,20),
            Cmds=make_set(CommandLine,10)
            by Computer, User, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where array_length(Signals) >= 2
| order by Earliest desc

title: Qilin/Agenda Ransomware Safe-Mode Boot Configuration via bcdedit
id: 8c5d1e2f-7a6b-4d8c-bf91-3c4e5d2f1a8e
status: experimental
description: Detects bcdedit being used to configure the system to boot into Safe Mode (network or minimal), a hallmark of Qilin (Agenda) ransomware which forces a reboot into Safe Mode to bypass EDR before encryption.
references:
  - https://www.sophos.com/en-us/content/the-state-of-ransomware
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1562/009/
author: detection-engineering
date: 2026/06/08
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'safeboot'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '/set'
      - '-set'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate troubleshooting by sysadmins (validate against change tickets)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.009
  - attack.t1490
  - detection.threat_hunting
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:4688 OR @EventID:1) @Image:(*\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE OR *\BcdEdit.exe) @CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *SafeBoot* OR *SAFEBOOT*) @CommandLine:(*/set* OR *-set*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i
| regex("safeboot", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| regex("[-/]set\\b", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)])
| sort(FirstSeen, order=desc)

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda GPO-distributed PowerShell harvesting Chrome credentials from domain endpoints
ucs.description: Hunts the novel Qilin tradecraft (Sophos, Aug 2024) of pushing a credential-stealer PowerShell logon script via Group Policy to harvest Chrome 'Login Data' / 'Local State' from every domain-joined endpoint at user logon. Catches the gpscript.exe/userinit.exe → powershell.exe → Chrome User Data access chain that no commodity infostealer or generic ransomware crew replicates at this scale.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd values(Processes.process_guid) as pguid from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("gpscript.exe","userinit.exe","winlogon.exe") OR Processes.parent_process="*gpscript*" OR Processes.parent_process="*\\Group Policy\\*") (Processes.process="*Login Data*" OR Processes.process="*Local State*" OR Processes.process="*Google\\Chrome\\User Data*" OR Processes.process="*Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data*" OR Processes.process="*Cookies*" OR Processes.process="*Web Data*" OR Processes.process="*Unprotect*" OR Processes.process="*CryptUnprotectData*" OR Processes.process="*AES_256_GCM*" OR Processes.process="*os_crypt*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user, ".*\$$") | join type=left dest user [| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count as ChromeFileTouches values(Filesystem.file_path) as files from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\*\\Login Data*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\Local State*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data\\*\\Login Data*") Filesystem.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`] | stats dc(dest) as HostCount values(dest) as Hosts values(parent) as Parents values(cmdline) as Cmdlines sum(ChromeFileTouches) as TotalChromeTouches by user | where HostCount >= 3 OR TotalChromeTouches > 0 | sort - HostCount
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let LogonScriptPS = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("gpscript.exe","userinit.exe","winlogon.exe")
         or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ ("gpscript.exe","userinit.exe")
         or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has @"\Group Policy\"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
         @"Google\Chrome\User Data", @"Microsoft\Edge\User Data",
         "Login Data", "Local State", "Web Data", "Cookies",
         "CryptUnprotectData", "Unprotect", "AES_256_GCM", "os_crypt",
         "DPAPI", "masterkey")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
              InitiatingProcessFolderPath, SHA256, DeviceId, ReportId;
let ChromeFileTouch = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Google\Chrome\User Data", @"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data")
    | where FileName in~ ("Login Data","Local State","Cookies","Web Data","Login Data-journal","Login Data For Account")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","brave.exe","GoogleUpdate.exe","GoogleUpdateOnDemand.exe","MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.exe","setup.exe")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","net.exe","esentutl.exe","robocopy.exe","xcopy.exe")
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              FolderPath, FileName, ActionType,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessParentFileName, DeviceId, ReportId;
// Fan-out signal: same script seen on many hosts within a tight window = GPO-distributed
let FanOut = LogonScriptPS
    | summarize HostCount = dcount(DeviceName),
                Hosts = make_set(DeviceName, 25),
                Earliest = min(Timestamp), Latest = max(Timestamp),
                SampleCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine)
                by AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName
    | where HostCount >= 3   // empirical: GPO logon-script Chrome dumpers hit dozens of hosts
                              //          within minutes; legit admin one-offs hit 1-2
    | extend FanOutWindowSec = datetime_diff('second', Latest, Earliest);
FanOut
| join kind=leftouter (
    ChromeFileTouch
    | summarize ChromeFileCount = count(),
                ChromeFiles = make_set(strcat(FolderPath,"\\",FileName), 20)
                by AccountName
) on AccountName
| project Earliest, Latest, FanOutWindowSec, AccountName,
          ChildProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          HostCount, Hosts, SampleCmd, ChromeFileCount, ChromeFiles
| order by Earliest desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let LogonScriptPS = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\pwsh.exe"
    | where ParentProcessName endswith "\\gpscript.exe"
         or ParentProcessName endswith "\\userinit.exe"
         or ParentProcessName endswith "\\winlogon.exe"
    | where CommandLine has_any (
         @"Google\Chrome\User Data", @"Microsoft\Edge\User Data",
         "Login Data", "Local State", "Web Data", "Cookies",
         "CryptUnprotectData", "Unprotect", "AES_256_GCM", "os_crypt",
         "DPAPI", "masterkey")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$" and TargetUserName !endswith "$"
    | extend AccountName = coalesce(TargetUserName, SubjectUserName)
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, AccountName, NewProcessName,

LogonScriptPS
| summarize HostCount = dcount(Computer),
            Hosts = make_set(Computer, 25),
            Earliest = min(TimeGenerated), Latest = max(TimeGenerated),
            SampleCmd = any(CommandLine),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName, 5)
            by AccountName, NewProcessName
| where HostCount >= 3
| extend FanOutWindowSec = datetime_diff('second', Latest, Earliest)
| order by Earliest desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe) @ParentImage:(*\gpscript.exe OR *\GPScript.exe OR *\userinit.exe OR *\Userinit.exe OR *\winlogon.exe) @CommandLine:(*"Login Data"* OR *"Local State"* OR *Chrome\\User?Data* OR *Edge\\User?Data* OR *CryptUnprotectData* OR *os_crypt* OR *AES_256_GCM* OR *DPAPI*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(gpscript|userinit|winlogon)\.exe$/i
| regex("(Google\\\\Chrome\\\\User Data|Microsoft\\\\Edge\\\\User Data|Login Data|Local State|CryptUnprotectData|os_crypt|AES_256_GCM|DPAPI|masterkey)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")

| HostCount >= 3
| sort(Earliest, order=desc)
